schema.text: When you walk, do car drivers make you feel unsafe?

ar.#When you walk, do car drivers make you: عند المشي، هل يُشعرك من يقودون السيارات بعدم الأمان؟

de.#When you walk, do car drivers make you: Fühlen Sie sich beim Gehen durch Autofahrende unsicher?

en.#When you walk, do car drivers make you: When you walk, do car drivers make you feel unsafe?

fa.#When you walk, do car drivers make you: هنگام پیاده‌روی، آیا رانندگان خودرو باعث می‌شوند احساس ناامنی کنید؟

fr.#When you walk, do car drivers make you: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause des personnes qui conduisent une voiture ?

hu.#When you walk, do car drivers make you: Gyaloglás közben az autóvezetők miatt érzi magát veszélyben?

it.#When you walk, do car drivers make you: Quando cammini, chi guida l’auto ti fa sentire in pericolo?

tr.#When you walk, do car drivers make you: Yürürken araba sürücüleri kendinizi güvensiz hissetmenize neden oluyor mu?
